title: Blood Resonance
next_chapter_hook: At the moment when that blurry coordinate exploded in his mind, Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes—that was the direction of the depths of the Holy Sect, and his sister was over there.

text.content: The pressure of the ancient existence was like an invisible mountain, crushing down on Chen Ji's chest. The power sleeping deep in his bloodline was like ignited gunpowder, completely erupting at this moment. Crimson-golden light poured out from his crown, transforming into a pillar of light shooting straight into the clouds. The cultivation barrier of the Nascent Divinity Initial Stage cracked with sounds, like ice and snow meeting the scorching sun.

Chen Ji felt that what was flowing through his meridians was no longer spiritual energy, but scorching magma. That was the mark branded by the Chen family's ancestor in the bloodline—'Heavenly Fate True Blood'. This power was tyrannically overwhelming, every inch of blood vessels roaring, every bone trembling. In the Mental Sea, the Tianji Record fragments flipped wildly, golden runes surging forth like a tide, creating a subtle resonance with the ancient existence's will.

dialogue.content: This was... the power of the ancestors?

text.content: From the first page of the Tianji Record, Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul voice sounded again: 'Finally... finally this day has come. The Chen family's bloodline, has finally awakened in the hands of the final disciple.' The voice carried a trembling, a relief, as if waiting for this moment had been an eternity. The ancient existence's will surged forward like a tide, not to attack, but to—bestow its legacy!

Countless scenes flickered before Chen Ji's eyes. Those were the images of the Chen family's ancestor, weaving the net of destiny together with the Tianji Record in ancient times. The ancestor's will was like a strict mentor, pouring all of his life's knowledge into Chen Ji's Mental Sea. Yet, the cost was tremendous—vast amounts of Heavenly Fate Value were consumed like flowing water, the number on the Tianji Record dropping sharply.

choice.prompt: The ancestor's power surged in, striking against the Nascent Divinity barrier. At the same time, Heavenly Fate Value was being consumed frantically. Now, you must make a choice—

choices.description: Regardless of life or death, fully absorb the ancestor's power to break through the cultivation bottleneck in one stroke. But this means Heavenly Fate Value will be exhausted, possibly affecting future foresight attempts.
choices.visible_reward: Strength breaks through to Golden Core Middle Stage, bloodline inheritance completeness reaches 60%
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate Value will drop to a dangerous level, foresight ability temporarily limited

text.content: Chen Ji gritted his teeth, fists clenched. He had no hesitation—if the ancestor's inheritance had descended at this moment, then it was heaven's will! He poured all his spiritual power into his Mental Sea, guiding that crimson-gold power to strike the Nascent Divinity barrier. Meridians roared, the elixir field trembled, and that seemingly impenetrable cultivation barrier was shattering inch by inch!

choices.text: Suppress awakening, protect Heavenly Fate Value
choices.description: Control the absorption rate of bloodline power, preserve some Heavenly Fate Value for emergencies. Breakthrough effect will be discounted, but more foresight ability can be preserved.
choices.visible_reward: Heavenly Fate Value only consumes 80 points, preserving more foresight attempts
choices.risk_hint: After breakthrough can only reach Nascent Divinity peak, unable to truly transform

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, displaying extraordinary composure before that berserk power. He began consciously suppressing the output speed of bloodline power, like taming a wild horse. Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded in his Mental Sea: 'Although this approach is conservative, it can preserve more backup plans... you are indeed more experienced than this old man imagined.'

choices.text: Channel part of the power to open a second elixir field
choices.description: Use bloodline power to open a second elixir field in the body, storing power separately. Can gain unique abilities, but the process is extremely dangerous.
choices.visible_reward: Gain the 'Dual Elixir Field' characteristic, spiritual energy reserves double, hidden strength greatly increased
choices.risk_hint: Failure will cause meridian damage, cultivation regress

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes flickered with a touch of madness. Since he wanted to become stronger, he would become the strongest! He guided a portion of his bloodline power, carving out a brand new space beside his lower dantian. It was an indescribable agony, as if someone was engraving his abdomen with red-hot iron bars. However, the moment the second dantian successfully took shape, Chen Ji felt an unprecedented sense of fullness.

Just at this moment, the Tianji Record completed its final resonance with the ancient existence's will. An elderly yet authoritative voice exploded directly in Chen Ji's mind: "Descendant of the Chen family, listen carefully—the Tianji Record is no ordinary object. It was cast from the painstaking efforts of our generations of prophets. And the true complete Tianji Record has nine pages..."

dialogue.content: "The nine pages of the Tianji Record are scattered throughout heaven and earth. Those who gather all nine pages may behold the full Heavenly Secrets and reverse fate itself. However, the price is—you will become a thorn in the eye of the Heavenly Dao's gaze." Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a hint of worry. "Throughout history, every one who gathered the Tianji Record, without exception, all perished."

text.content: Chen Ji felt a磅礴 surge of energy gushing from the depths of his bloodline, washing through his meridians and reshaping his dantian. The barrier of the initial Transformation God stage completely shattered with a clear, crisp sound. A brand new power circulated through his body. The hallmark of Golden Core stage—that thumb-sized golden core—was slowly forming in his dantian!

choice.prompt: Just as the golden core was about to take shape, Chen Ji sensed a familiar aura drifting from afar. That was—Chen Nian! His sister's location was now crystal clear in his mind.

choices.text: Track the aura and move immediately.
choices.description: Chen Nian's position has been locked—she is within the Holy Sect's forbidden grounds. Rush to rescue her immediately and don't give them a chance to relocate her.
choices.visible_cost: Just broke through, foundations are unstable.
choices.visible_reward: Possibly rescue Chen Nian, siblings reunite.
choices.risk_hint: The Holy Sect is a dragon's pool and tiger's den—rushing in recklessly would be extremely dangerous.

text.content: Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes, a flash of crimson-gold flickering across his pupils. His divine sense, following the bloodline's pull, probed toward the Holy Sect. In the blurry vision, he saw a young girl bound by chains—that was Chen Nian! His younger sister was enduring unimaginable suffering. "Wait for me..." Chen Ji murmured, "Brother will rescue you."

choices.text: Hold position and scheme in secret.
choices.description: The Holy Sect is powerful—rash action would be suicidal. First stabilize your cultivation, contact allies, and plan carefully.
choices.visible_cost: Chen Nian may continue to suffer.
choices.visible_reward: More preparation time and a more complete plan.

text.content: Chen Ji forcibly suppressed the restlessness in his heart. Years of strategic experience told him—the more critical the moment, the calmer he must remain. The Holy Sect was no pushover; rushing in recklessly would only alert the enemy. He began mentally simulating various possibilities: contacting Ye Qing's demonic path forces, leveraging Su Qingyao's resources within the Tianqing Sect, even considering temporary cooperation with Han Lie... All the pieces rapidly arranged in his mind.

The Tianji Record Fragment flipped again, and information directly poured into Chen Ji's mind: "Heavenly Fate Lock—Chen Nian. She is the key sacrificial offering for an ancient ritual the Holy Sect is conducting. If not rescued within three months, the Heavenly Fate Lock will be fully activated. At that time—she will become a piece on the Heavenly Dao's chessboard, forever unable to escape."

"Three months..." Chen Ji's fists tightly clenched, his knuckles white. The Holy Sect, the Demonic Path, the Three Great Sects—each faction was a behemoth, and he had to carve a blood-soaked path through this intricate chess game. The text on the Tianji Record flickered, seemingly urging yet also warning. Mo Xiansheng's voice emerged again: "Child, are you certain you wish to walk this path?"

dialogue.content: Chen Ji raised his head, gazing toward the distant horizon. An unprecedented determination burned in his eyes: "She is my only sister. If I cannot even protect my family, what's the point of cultivating immortality and calculating the heavens?" His voice was soft, yet carried an unwavering resolve. "This game... I accept."

text.content: No sooner had the words fallen than a strange power gushed forth from the Tianji Record, resonating with Chen Ji's bloodline. A blurry vision materialized before his eyes—in the Holy Sect's forbidden depths, Chen Nian was bound by countless chains on a massive altar, surrounded by eerie runes. And at the altar's center, a vague silhouette was silently observing everything... That was—

The vision abruptly ceased. Chen Ji snapped back to reality, discovering his back was drenched in cold sweat. The horror of the Heavenly Dao's gaze once again gave him a visceral experience. He took a deep breath, steadying his violently pounding heart. Fear was not an option now—he needed allies, needed intelligence, needed an absolutely foolproof plan. Ye Qing, Su Qingyao... and those hidden pieces in the shadows, all were forces he could mobilize.

In the critical moment when Chen Ji was stabilizing his realm, a deafening rumble suddenly echoed from the sky. The ancient existence's will had completely dissipated, but the lingering pressure still evoked profound reverence among cultivators for a thousand miles. Countless divine senses probed from all directions, eager to investigate. Chen Ji realized—his breakthrough's commotion was too massive, likely already attracting the attention of various powers.

"Interesting..." A cold, sinister voice drifted from the horizon. "The Tianqing Sect has actually produced a remarkable figure." Chen Ji's pupils abruptly constricted—that was Ling Yuan's aura! The old Sect Master had personally appeared. Immediately after, another familiar presence approached from nearby—Su Qingyao, rushing toward him at full speed, her face carrying an expression of barely concealable worry.

Ling Yuan's oppressive pressure descended like an invisible mountain, yet it was deflected by some mysterious force when approaching within three zhang of Chen Ji. The old Sect Master's eyes flickered with a hint of astonishment, then quickly returned to calm: "It seems I have underestimated you, young fellow." His gaze fixed on Chen Ji, as if examining a priceless treasure. "Chen Ji, would you be willing to take me as your master? I can personally guide you and help you achieve the supreme great dao."

dialogue.content: Chen Ji slightly clasped his hands in greeting, his face wearing a perfectly appropriate expression of being overwhelmed by the honor: "What virtue do I possess that I would receive such favor from the Sect Master? Only, this disciple is foolish and slow-witted, afraid I will disappoint the Sect Master's expectations." His voice was humble, yet his eyes were as cold as ice. In Ling Yuan's heart, he had already seen clearly—this old fox merely wished to bring him under his wing, to control him in the shadows.

text.content: The moment that blurry coordinate exploded in his mind, Chen Ji suddenly opened his eyes—that was the direction of the Holy Sect's depths, and his younger sister was right there.
